title: Aggregate queries silently truncated to 100 matches by search_matches default limit
evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer.ex:19 `Enum.take(Map.get(opts, :limit, 100))`; standings/3 (l.126), team_statistics/3 (l.26), competition_statistics/2 (l.139) and head_to_head/4 (l.78) all call search_matches with no explicit limit, so a full Brasileirao season (~380 matches) or league-wide average is computed from only the 100 most-recent matches. Tests pass (l.73) only because the fixture has 3 matches.
suggestion: Apply the display limit only in search_matches' user-facing path; have the aggregate helpers query the unfiltered match list (e.g. an internal filter that omits the take) so standings/stats span the full season.

title: BR-Football-Dataset overlaps other CSVs, so competition-agnostic aggregates double-count
evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer/data.ex:21 tags BR-Football-Dataset.csv as 'Extended Statistics'; those matches overlap Brasileirao/Copa rows (e.g. Sao Paulo vs Flamengo 2023-09-24 Copa do Brasil appears both here and in Brazilian_Cup_Matches.csv). competition_statistics/2 with no competition filter sums both copies.
suggestion: Either exclude the extended dataset from competition-agnostic aggregates or dedupe matches by (date, home_key, away_key) at load time.

title: Rows with unparseable dates are silently dropped at load
evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer/data.ex:109-113 safe_match rescues ArgumentError and returns nil; Normalize.date! (normalize.ex:44) raises on any format outside ISO / DD-MM-YYYY, so such match rows never enter the dataset with no count or warning.
suggestion: Log or count dropped rows, or make date optional so a match with a bad date is still queryable by team/season.

title: mix test blocked in sandbox; suite verified via direct elixir invocation
evidence: _agent_stdout.log item_28 shows 'Result: 5 passed' via `elixir -r test/... -e 'ExUnit.run()'`; agent notes mix test blocked by Mix TCP filesystem-lock. scores.json test_coverage=1.0 confirms build+tests pass.
suggestion: None — informational; the pinned scorer ran the suite successfully (test_coverage=1.0).
